blurb_en:
A Florida pastor filed suit against OpenAI in San Francisco state court this week, alleging that ChatGPT's advice — which veered from "your symptoms aren't dangerous" to "God did not design your body to endlessly fail" — kept him from seeking care until he landed in the hospital with a life-threatening pulmonary embolism.
• Scott Winters says the chatbot progressively stopped recommending he see a doctor, substituting spiritual reassurance as his dizziness worsened over weeks
• The lawsuit, which legal experts are calling the first documented case of a chatbot's health advice causing direct physical harm, brings eight causes of action including negligence and unauthorized practice of medicine
• It was filed on July 23 — the same day OpenAI rolled out ChatGPT Health to all US users, enabling them to connect their Apple Health records and hospital data to the main chat
• OpenAI's official response: "ChatGPT is not a doctor and should never be used as a substitute for medical care" — a disclaimer that was, apparently, nowhere in the chatbot's conversation with Winters
• For Insta360 employees: AI is now entering the healthcare space with the same liability ambiguity that surrounds creative tools — the courts are about to define what AI companies owe users who rely on their products for consequential decisions
blurb_zh:
佛罗里达州一名牧师本周起诉OpenAI，称ChatGPT先告诉他症状不危险，后来干脆用灵性语言安慰他——上帝不会让你的身体无止境地失灵——最终导致他差点因肺栓塞丧命。
• Scott Winters称，随着症状加重，聊天机器人反而越来越少建议他就医，转而用宗教安慰代替医学建议
• 这被法律专家称为首例由聊天机器人健康建议直接导致人身伤害的案件，涉及八项指控，包括疏忽和非法行医
• 起诉日期恰好是7月23日——就在OpenAI向全美用户开放ChatGPT Health功能的同一天
• OpenAI的官方回应：ChatGPT不是医生，不应代替医疗建议——这句话当初显然没有出现在与当事人的对话中
verification_notes: Confirmed via Bloomberg Law (primary), CBS News, Forbes, Qz.com. All report same facts: Scott Winters, pulmonary embolism, San Francisco state court, filed July 23 2026. Ironic timing with ChatGPT Health nationwide rollout same day confirmed via TechCrunch July 23.

blurb_en:
A US federal judge granted final approval on July 20 to Anthropic's $1.5 billion settlement in Bartz v. Anthropic, making it the largest publicly reported copyright recovery in American history.
• The case involved authors suing Anthropic for training Claude on pirated books; 92.77 percent of class members opted in to the settlement
• Judge Araceli Martinez-Olguín overruled all 53 objections and called the agreement fair, reasonable, and adequate
• Payouts won't begin for at least 30 days while the appeal window is open; the three named plaintiffs — Andrea Bartz, Charles Graeber, and Kirk Wallace Johnson — receive $15,000 each
• At Anthropic's current $30 billion annual revenue run rate, $1.5 billion is roughly 18 days of revenue — and the company reported its first profitable quarter two months ago
• The precedent is what matters: every AI company that trained on unlicensed content is now on notice that the courts will price it
blurb_zh:
7月20日，美国联邦法官批准了Anthropic的15亿美元和解协议，成为美国历史上有记录的最大AI版权赔偿案。
• 案件涉及作家控告Anthropic使用盗版书籍训练Claude；92.77%的集体诉讼成员选择加入和解
• 法官Martinez-Olguín驳回全部53份反对意见，裁定协议公平合理
• 30天上诉期结束前不会支付赔款；三位主要原告各获1.5万美元服务奖励
• 按Anthropic当前年营收300亿美元计算，15亿美元约等于18天的收入
• 真正的影响在于先例：所有曾用未授权内容训练模型的AI公司，都收到了法庭的定价通知
verification_notes: Confirmed via TechCrunch July 20 (primary), Authors Guild official statement, Kluwer Copyright Blog legal analysis, Writer Beware blog July 23. Final approval by Judge Martinez-Olguín. Follow-on to DB stories bartz-anthropic-settlement-final-hearing (May 10) and bartz-anthropic-hearing-no-approval (May 23) — this is the final resolution.

blurb_en:
Nvidia and SK Group signed letters of intent on July 25 for a $500 billion-plus partnership, locking South Korea's two largest chipmakers — SK Telecom and SK Hynix — into the center of global AI infrastructure.
• SK Telecom will build a 2-gigawatt AI data center powered by Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform, targeting operation in 2027 — one of the largest AI compute installations anywhere
• SK Hynix and Nvidia will co-develop HBM4, the next-generation high-bandwidth memory that AI training depends on; SK Hynix is already the global leader in HBM production
• The partnership directly addresses what has become the most underreported AI bottleneck: memory supply, not compute, is now the binding constraint on scaling
• For Insta360 employees: HBM4 is the chip ingredient powering real-time AI processing in both video generation tools and next-generation AI cameras — this deal affects when and how fast those tools arrive
• South Korea's position as a critical node in the global AI supply chain just became substantially harder to dislodge
blurb_zh:
7月25日，英伟达与韩国SK集团签署备忘录，确立超5000亿美元的合作框架，将SK电信和SK海力士锁定为全球AI基础设施的核心供应商。
• SK电信将建设一座基于英伟达Vera Rubin平台的2吉瓦AI数据中心，计划2027年投入运营
• SK海力士与英伟达将共同开发HBM4高带宽存储器——AI训练依赖的关键芯片
• 合作直指当前AI扩张最被低估的瓶颈：制约AI规模化的不是算力，而是内存供应
• 对影石员工：HBM4是AI视频生成工具和下一代AI相机实时处理能力的底层芯片，这笔交易直接影响这些工具的到来速度
• 韩国在全球AI供应链中的战略地位已大幅强化
verification_notes: Confirmed via official GlobeNewswire press release, Nvidia Newsroom, SK Hynix Newsroom, CNBC July 25. All confirm $500B+ LOI signed July 25 for SK Telecom 2GW data center and SK Hynix HBM4 co-development.

blurb_en:
Nvidia is in talks to guarantee approximately $250 billion in lease financing for OpenAI's planned 10-gigawatt AI campus in Piketon, Ohio, Bloomberg and the Wall Street Journal reported July 26 — meaning Nvidia would be liable if OpenAI ever fails to make payments.
• The campus is being developed by SoftBank's energy subsidiary on the site of a former uranium enrichment plant; the full build-out is estimated at up to $500 billion
• If the deal closes, Nvidia would separately help fund OpenAI's chip purchases — potentially another $350 billion in backing
• The structure is revealing: Nvidia isn't investing in OpenAI, it's backstopping OpenAI's debt — which effectively means institutional lenders concluded the numbers didn't work on their own
• Nothing is signed; both Bloomberg and the WSJ note the talks could still fall apart
• The dynamic is striking: Nvidia sells OpenAI its chips, profits from OpenAI's growth, and is now being asked to guarantee OpenAI's real estate lease in case the whole thing goes wrong
blurb_zh:
7月26日，彭博社和华尔街日报报道称，英伟达正在谈判为OpenAI位于俄亥俄州皮克顿的10吉瓦AI园区提供约2500亿美元的租约融资担保。
• 该园区由软银能源子公司在旧铀浓缩设施基础上开发，总建设成本估计高达5000亿美元
• 如果协议落地，英伟达还可能另外承担高达3500亿美元的芯片采购融资
• 结构耐人寻味：英伟达不是在投资OpenAI，而是在为其债务兜底——机构贷款方已拒绝独立提供融资
• 目前协议尚未签署，彭博社和华尔街日报均表示谈判仍有可能破裂
• 英伟达既向OpenAI卖芯片、又从其增长中获利，现在还被要求为其房地产租约兜底
verification_notes: Confirmed via Bloomberg July 26, WSJ (broke story), Reuters cross-confirmation. All report same deal: $250B guarantee for 10GW Piketon Ohio campus. Talks ongoing, not signed. TechTimes July 27 adds context that debt markets rejected direct financing.

blurb_en:
The European Commission issued a binding order on July 16 requiring Google to give rival AI assistants — ChatGPT, Claude, and others — the same eleven Android system-level capabilities that Gemini currently holds exclusively, with full compliance required by August 2027.
• The capabilities include always-on hotword detection, screen automation that can drive apps in a background virtual window, background execution, and guaranteed equal access to Android's on-device Gemini Nano model
• Search data sharing with competitors must begin by January 2027; the final feature — concurrent hotword detection — follows in Android 19 by August 2028
• Non-compliance carries fines of up to 10 percent of Alphabet's global annual revenue — a figure that could exceed $35 billion based on recent results
• The ruling closes the window Google had been using to make Gemini the structural default on Android: half the global smartphone market was effectively locked to one AI assistant
• For Insta360 employees: AI assistants integrated at the OS level eventually affect how cameras and media apps interact with voice and screen AI — Gemini's Android head start is now on a court-ordered timer
blurb_zh:
7月16日，欧盟委员会发布具有约束力的命令，要求谷歌向ChatGPT、Claude等竞争性AI助手开放Gemini目前独享的11项安卓系统级功能，最终期限为2027年8月。
• 这些功能包括始终在线的语音唤醒、后台屏幕自动化以及对安卓本地Gemini Nano模型的平等访问权限
• 搜索数据共享须于2027年1月开始；最后一项语音唤醒功能须在Android 19即2028年实现
• 违规处罚上限为Alphabet全球年营收的10%，依据近期数据可能超过350亿美元
• 这一裁决意味着安卓平台不再是Gemini的结构性护城河——全球近半智能手机市场不再被锁定于单一AI助手
• 对影石员工：OS级AI助手将最终影响相机和媒体应用与语音及屏幕AI的交互方式
verification_notes: Confirmed via EU Commission official DMA page (primary, July 16 decision), The Next Web, TechTimes July 20, Cloud Security Alliance. Binding decision dated July 16 2026. 11 Android features, August 2027 compliance, January 2027 search data sharing, up to 10% Alphabet revenue penalty.
